label: Probation: maximum period the reduced minimum wage may apply
unit: months from the start of probation
appliesTo: Employees on probation under a contract of one year or more, outside simple labour occupations
why: Routinely misreported as a limit on probation itself. It is not — probation can run longer; only the reduced minimum wage is capped at this. Conflating the two lets an employer justify a longer pay reduction than the law allows, and lets an employee think a six-month probation is automatically unlawful when it is not.

history.note: Within the first three months of probation, and only where the employment contract runs for a year or more, the employee is genuinely on probation, and the occupation is not one designated as simple labour, minimum wage may be applied at 90%. It caps the reduction, not the probation period, and it says nothing about reducing a contracted salary above the minimum wage.
